claim: A floor or ceiling texel is 16 map units (8 with floorstat/ceilingstat bit 3, 'double smooshiness'), and unless bit 6 (relative alignment) is set the pattern is laid on the map's own grid. Moving a sector by anything but a whole number of its tile's period (pixels x 16) shifts its floor pattern; a 64-pixel crate tile covers 1,024 units, a 128-pixel one 2,048.
evidence: NBlood/source/build/src/engine.cpp:2797-2799 globalxshift from the tile's size, one more with globalorientation&8
NBlood/source/build/include/buildtypes.h:24 bit 3 double smooshiness; :27 bit 6 align texture to first wall
use: Size floor-textured modules from the art (pixels x 16); translate geometry only by whole periods (Gravesend's release shift is 16,384: four of its longest tile's period, and on the 1,024 plan grid).
